page_title: BAY 6-2 FRE | Bayern Munich v Freiburg 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' A shot from the edge of the box by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.

90+3' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
90+2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich).
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

90' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.

89' What a huge chance for Igor Matanovic (Freiburg). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
86' Freiburg fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.

84' 6 - 2 Goal! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the left post. Noah Atubolu had no chance of reaching it. The score is 6:2.
83' Here comes a substitution. Wisdom Mike (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Harry Kane.
83' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Aleksandar Pavlovic and he is replaced by Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich).
82' A pass by Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
78' 5 - 2 Goal - 5:2! Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass inside the box from Michael Olise and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
77' It is time for a substitution. Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is on for Yuito Suzuki.
77' Here is a change. Max Rosenfelder is going off and Julian Schuster gives the last tactical orders to Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg).
77' Dayot Upamecano will be replaced by Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich).

76' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.

75' Unlucky! A great strike from Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
73' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) works the corner short.

73' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayern Munich will take a corner.
72' The attendance for today's match is 75000.
71' Lennart Karl is substituted due to injury. Vincent Kompany gives a chance to Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich).

69' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
68' Neat passing move from Bayern Munich in order to create new attacking opportunities.
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) for Johan Manzambi.
64' Substitution. Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Derry Scherhant walks off.
64' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) replaces Lucas Holer.
62' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
60' 4 - 2 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) latches on to an accurate pass and quickly strikes a low effort inside the right post.
59' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
55' 3 - 2 Goal! Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:2.
55' Bayern Munich win a corner.
52' The goal by Bayern Munich won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
52' The Bayern Munich players halt their celebrations as referee Sven Jablonski makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
52' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Bayern Munich.
50' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
49' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) brings his opponent down. Sven Jablonski has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Freiburg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

48' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
46' Here comes a substitution. Leon Goretzka is given a rest as he is replaced by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.

45+3' Ambitious effort from Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
45+2' 2 - 2 Goal! Lennart Karl pulls the ball back for Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike inside the right post. 2:2.
45+2' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Noah Atubolu.
45+1' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' The Bayern Munich players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
42' Bayern Munich quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
42' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Bayern Munich have a corner.
40' Booking. Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) receives a caution from the referee.
40' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) brings an opponent down and Sven Jablonski interrupts the game. Freiburg have a free kick.

38' What a chance that is! Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
37' A pass from Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by Noah Atubolu and the move breaks down.
35' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
34' The game is interrupted now, Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is penalised for holding. Sven Jablonski signals a set piece. There is a free kick near the sideline to Freiburg.
31' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
30' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
28' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
27' Bayern Munich are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
25' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
22' 1 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) was set free in the area by Michael Olise and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the left side of the net. 1:2.

21' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) who loops his header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
21' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
17' 0 - 2 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header into the middle of the goal. He makes it 0:2.
17' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
16' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich). Sven Jablonski saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Freiburg earn a free kick.
15' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle after Lucas Holer (Freiburg) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
12' 0 - 1 Goal! Matthias Ginter tees up Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 0:1.
12' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
11' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
9' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball is behind the touchline and Freiburg will take a throw-in.

7' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich will take a throw-in.
4' Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
2' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the left post. He should have scored!
1' The match has just started.
Freiburg will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Sven Jablonski.
